question: How many customers are there?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Customer

question: How many tracks are in the database?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Track

question: List the names of all genres.
sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre

question: How many customers live in Brazil?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

question: What is the longest track's name?
sql: SELECT Name FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the average invoice total?
sql: SELECT avg(Total) FROM Invoice

question: How many distinct countries do our customers come from?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT Country) FROM Customer

question: What are the names of all media types?
sql: SELECT Name FROM MediaType

question: What is the largest single invoice total?
sql: SELECT max(Total) FROM Invoice

question: List the first and last names of all employees.
sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee

question: How many playlists are there?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Playlist

question: What is the total revenue across all invoices?
sql: SELECT sum(Total) FROM Invoice

question: Which cities in Canada have customers?
sql: SELECT DISTINCT City FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Canada'

question: How many tracks cost more than 0.99?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Track WHERE UnitPrice > 0.99

question: What is the title of the employee named Nancy Edwards?
sql: SELECT Title FROM Employee WHERE FirstName = 'Nancy' AND LastName = 'Edwards'

question: How many albums are there?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Album

question: How many invoices were billed to Germany?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'Germany'

question: What is the shortest track's length in milliseconds?
sql: SELECT min(Milliseconds) FROM Track

question: Which composer is credited on the track named 'Balls to the Wall'?
sql: SELECT Composer FROM Track WHERE Name = 'Balls to the Wall'

question: How many customers have no company listed?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Customer WHERE Company IS NULL

question: How many albums does the artist AC/DC have?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Album a JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: How many tracks are there in each genre? Give the genre name and the count.
sql: SELECT g.Name, count(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name

question: Which artist has the most albums? Give only the artist's name.
sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album a ON ar.ArtistId = a.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total invoiced amount for each billing country? Give the country and the total.
sql: SELECT BillingCountry, sum(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry

question: Which country has the highest total invoice amount? Give only the country.
sql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY sum(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the names of the tracks on the album 'Let There Be Rock'.
sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'

question: How many customers does each support representative handle? Give the employee's first name, last name and the count.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, count(*) FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName

question: How many customers are there in each country? Give the country and the count.
sql: SELECT Country, count(*) FROM Customer GROUP BY Country

question: What is the average track length in milliseconds for the Rock genre?
sql: SELECT avg(t.Milliseconds) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock'

question: Which genre has the most tracks? Give only the genre name.
sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks are on the playlist named 'Music Videos'?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM PlaylistTrack pt JOIN Playlist p ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Music Videos'

question: Which media type is used by the most tracks? Give only its name.
sql: SELECT m.Name FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was the total invoice amount in the year 2023?
sql: SELECT sum(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2023'

question: How many invoices were issued in each year? Give the year and the count.
sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate), count(*) FROM Invoice GROUP BY strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate)

question: What is the first and last name of the customer with the highest single invoice?
sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId ORDER BY i.Total DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which albums have more than 20 tracks? Give the album titles.
sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title HAVING count(*) > 20

question: How many tracks does the artist Metallica have?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Metallica'

question: Which employees report to Nancy Edwards? Give their first and last names.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Employee m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId WHERE m.FirstName = 'Nancy' AND m.LastName = 'Edwards'

question: Which customers have never been assigned a support representative? Give the number of such customers.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Customer WHERE SupportRepId IS NULL

question: How many different tracks have been sold at least once?
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT TrackId) FROM InvoiceLine

question: Which genre brought in the most revenue from invoice lines? Give only the genre name.
sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY sum(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which artist earned the most revenue from invoice lines? Give only the artist's name.
sql: SELECT ar.Name FROM Artist ar JOIN Album a ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY sum(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which support representative's customers generated the most invoice revenue? Give the employee's first and last name.
sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName ORDER BY sum(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers have spent more than 40 in total? Give the number.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerId FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING sum(Total) > 40)

question: How many tracks have never been sold?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Track WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine)

question: Which artists have no albums? Give the number of such artists.
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Artist WHERE ArtistId NOT IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM Album)

question: What is the average number of tracks per album?
sql: SELECT avg(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId)

question: Which album has the longest total running time? Give only its title.
sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId GROUP BY a.AlbumId, a.Title ORDER BY sum(t.Milliseconds) DESC LIMIT 1

question: In which month of 2022 was the invoice total highest? Give the month as a two-digit number.
sql: SELECT strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2022' GROUP BY strftime('%m', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY sum(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many customers bought at least one Jazz track? Count each customer once.
sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'

question: Which country has the highest average invoice total, among countries with more than 10 invoices? Give only the country.
sql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING count(*) > 10 ORDER BY avg(Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many tracks does the largest playlist contain?
sql: SELECT max(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM PlaylistTrack GROUP BY PlaylistId)

question: What percentage of tracks belong to the Rock genre? Give a number from 0 to 100.
sql: SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN g.Name = 'Rock' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId

question: Who is the top customer in the USA by total spend? Give the first and last name.
sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'USA' GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY sum(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which employee is the manager of the most people? Give the first and last name.
sql: SELECT m.FirstName, m.LastName FROM Employee m JOIN Employee e ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId GROUP BY m.EmployeeId, m.FirstName, m.LastName ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many albums contain tracks from more than one genre?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT AlbumId FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId HAVING count(DISTINCT GenreId) > 1)

question: What is the revenue from invoice lines for the artist Iron Maiden?
sql: SELECT sum(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId JOIN Album a ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = a.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden'

question: How many invoices contain more than 10 line items?
sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT InvoiceId FROM InvoiceLine GROUP BY InvoiceId HAVING count(*) > 10)

question: What is the largest number of different tracks bought by any one customer?
sql: SELECT max(n) FROM (SELECT count(DISTINCT il.TrackId) AS n FROM Invoice i JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.CustomerId)

question: What is the average total spend per customer?
sql: SELECT avg(s) FROM (SELECT sum(Total) AS s FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId)
